title: BioVAT pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided, cannot contain spaces or full stops

library_id.errorMessage: Sequencing library ID must be provided, cannot contain spaces or full stops

flowcell_id.errorMessage: Flowcell ID must be provided, cannot contain spaces or full stops

lane.errorMessage: Lane number must be a positive integer

platform.errorMessage: Sequencing platform must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2, if provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'. Omit for single-end reads

bam.errorMessage: Aligned BAM file, if provided in place of fastq_1/fastq_2, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.bam'

single_end.errorMessage: BAM input only: must be true (single-end data) or false (paired-end data)

errorMessage.oneOf: Each row must provide either fastq_1 and optionally fastq_2, or bam and single_end.
